value.rationale: The twelve hyperflex tangents of one of the only two characteristic-zero smooth plane quartics with the maximum twelve hyperflexes are canonically motivated; their complex general-position property contrasts with the other extremal quartic. The complete prime obstruction and the two structurally different arithmetic degenerations (new six quadruple concurrences at 3, collapse onto quartic components at 5) determine a natural geometric invariant across all odd primes, and Frobenius distinguishes rational from geometric incidence. This is not arbitrary parameter slicing or merely a sampled count.
